name: touch
description: See what the subagents in a Claude Code session are doing: a read-only, loopback-only, token-gated dashboard over the live agent tree, plus ten skills — four deterministic research and implement orchestration skills, and six engineering-practice ones for architecture, testing, refactoring, design patterns and code review. It reads your transcripts under ~/.claude/projects/, keeps its own state inside the project you run it in (the optional Mongo mirror in docs/mongo.md is off by default), and installs one PreToolUse hook that stays inert unless an orchestration run is active.

run_scope_guard.title: Run the orchestration scope guard
run_scope_guard.description: Run the PreToolUse run-scope guard. It is already inert unless .claude/local-orchestrators/ACTIVE exists in your project; set this to false to disable the hook outright.
